injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) won't play Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
Kalkbrenner has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against Memphis due to left hip soreness. He'll end with two rebounds in nine minutes.
Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
